compatibility_revision: v1 GPT-4.1 mini and v2 Claude Haiku smoke returned403 violence/graphic despite factual academic context. Before main inference, replace OpenAI seats with Qwen3-VL8B/Gemma3-12B and Claude with Mistral Small3.2-24B. Preserve original images/context, failed attempts and all liabilities; do not retry blocked requests. No further model selection after this compatibility attempt in this task.
medical_context: System prompt and first input JSON field academic_context state the actual academic surgical-video annotation purpose. This is context, not a request to disable provider safeguards; blocked requests remain failures.
target_selection: Reuse all eight frozen Training H0 targets from prior-panel v7, in unchanged order; already examined, not independent confirmation
aggregation: arithmetic mean of exactly five complete integer scores, no cross-round pooling
uncertain_policy: 2 < mean < 4 is not actionable; retain H0 for unsupported net edits
scope: full catalog: 7 instrument + 10 verb + 15 target + 100 IVT; Phase frozen
repair: Only score-disagreement issues; at most16 explicit local edits; require full next five-model review before admission
component_policy: No full projection; new IVT needs existing or independently supported components; component deletion cannot break a retained IVT
first_round: five blind predictions without H0; compare scores to H0 in Python
later_rounds: draft plus same model's previous answer, never other models' answers or means
early_stop: no actionable score disagreement, empty or invalid patch, invalid/incomplete panel, budget stop, or third review completed; repeated issue alone does not force early stop
failure: retain last completely reviewed state; never average four responses as five; cost-missing call retains full reservation and stops new dispatch
prior: No GT-derived prior fed to this variant; full class coverage replaces fixed candidate restriction
comparators: same H0, previous three-vote prior/no-prior results, D1/D2/D3 prefixes; this changes several mechanisms and is not a single-factor ablation
evaluation: GT only joined after saved prediction completion; independent task masks; F1, set accuracy, beneficial/harmful/no-benefit edits, failures, calls, native fees and unknown reservations
budget: shared original15USD, subtract all six previous paid run ledgers; no budget reset
limitations: Two Gemini variants are related; Qwen repair and Qwen-VL reviewer are related; ratings are not calibrated probabilities; correlated visual errors and self-anchoring can persist; repeated images supply no new external evidence
